style: Main title theme of a lonely retro pixel-art space game: a slow, dark, spacey 1980s sci-fi film synth score, deep space ambient. Cold analog synthesizer pads swelling with slow filter sweeps, a sub-bass drone on a pedal tone, a soft low 16th-note arpeggiator, a sparse melancholic square-wave lead with slow vibrato and tape echo, a felt piano and a lonely cello answering, faint glass bells, a soft slow pulse like a blinking lamp; vast reverb and space. Dark, mysterious, desolate and melancholic. Purely instrumental. Dm, 92 BPM.
